page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; a handwritten note block in the right margin (manuscript annotations, not printed text, described under notes). Running head at top left and centre, page number and chapter label at top right. Ornament band, then centred headings, then the body text.

main_text.head: CAPUT SECUNDUM.
DE PRINCIPIIS AC CAVSIS NOSTRA SENTENTIA.
SECTIO PRIMA.
main_text.p: I. Notio ac vis vocabuli Principij in vulgato loquendi usu. Principium & Initium, idem. II. Suarezij fluctuationes, super primaria ac vulgata hujus vocis notione. Primus in ordine loci non recte dicitur Principium eorum, qui post ipsum: III. Ita neq; Primogenitus, Principium dicendus reliquorum liberorum. Hebraica vox Reschith, multo latius patet, quam Graeca ἀρχὴ, aut Latina Principium. IV. Philosophicus vocis Principij usus, incertissimus apud Aristotelem, atq; ad plurimas diversissimas res promiscue accommodatus. V. Enumeratio significationum hujus vocabuli, non rite facta ab Aristotele in initio quinti Metaphysicorum. VI. Ineptissimus Aristotelicorum conatus, ad distorquendum illud magistri sui dictum, ubi conceptis verbis fatetur, Causam & Principium reciproce dici. VII. Censura Aristotelis, super isto vocum abusu vaga.

page.notes: Handwritten manuscript annotations in the right margin (English-style notes in pen, partly illegible) and interlinear pencil or ink marks above the text are not printed and are not transcribed. Several printed words in the text carry small superscript corrections (e.g. "Usus", "Employ", "inconstantissimus", "synonymia") that are manuscript insertions. Greek words in the text transcribed as best read; the accents may be imperfect.
